segments.name: Sealing Systems
segments.description: Makes sealing systems such as body seals for passenger vehicles and light trucks sold mainly to global automotive original equipment manufacturers.
segments.evidence: For the periods presented herein, our business was organized in two reportable segments: Sealing Systems and Fluid Handling Systems.

segments.name: Fluid Handling Systems
segments.description: Makes fluid handling systems, including fuel and brake delivery and fluid transfer, for passenger vehicles and light trucks sold to automakers and suppliers.
segments.evidence: eCoFlow™ switch pump, a solution that offers features of both an electric water pump and electronically driven valve in a single integrated coolant control module

revenueModel.text: Global automotive original equipment manufacturers and other suppliers and distributors pay for sealing and fluid handling systems.
revenueModel.evidence: Approximately 86% of our sales in 2025 were to OEMs.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company divested its European technical rubber products business and its controlling interest in an Asia Pacific joint venture.
changes.evidence: In 2023, we finalized the divestiture of our European technical rubber products business and sold the Company's entire controlling equity interest in a joint venture in the Asia Pacific region.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold its Canadian tooling business.
changes.evidence: Gain on sale of businesses, net for the year ended December 31, 2024 was $2.0 million, resulting from the net effect of the sale of our Canadian tooling business.
